title: Savory Vegan Oozing Soup
description: A hearty, comforting soup made with oozing goodness and a kick of spice. Perfect for a cozy night in.

ingredients.name: Oozing
ingredients.notes: Oozing liquid, such as soy sauce or tamari

instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat the oozing liquid over medium heat.
Add the chopped scallions and cook until fragrant.
Add the chopped chili pepper and cook for an additional minute.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
